filing_office: Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs, Corporations Division
filing_fee_notes: Standard domestic LLC formation fee is 50. Annual Statement costs 25; professional LLC annual filings have different fees.
registered_agent_rules: Include a resident agent and Michigan registered office in the Articles. Eligible agents include Michigan residents and qualifying domestic or authorized foreign corporations or LLCs.
expedite_options: Additional formation charges in the official schedule: 50 for 24-hour service, 100 for same-day service, 500 for two-hour service or 1000 for one-hour service.
annual_report_due: February 15 each year after formation. An LLC formed after September 30 skips the immediately following February 15 filing.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Michigan Unemployment Insurance Agency, Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and maintain a Michigan resident agent. File the Annual Statement unless the first-year timing exception applies.
common_mistake: Using the professional LLC filing fee for a standard LLC.
notes: Standard domestic LLC scope, not PLLC. Standard formation processing time, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null. Paid expedite options come from the official fee schedule.
